transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. Let me walk through the specific privacy gaps I've identified. First, the platform will be processing identifiable customer call transcripts, which brings it squarely within the scope of our approved data-processing standard. That standard sets four hard requirements that are not yet reflected in the contract redline. First, we need a mandatory deletion clause requiring the vendor to delete all customer content within exactly 7 calendar days after termination of the agreement — the current draft is silent on a specific deletion timeline. Second, the contract must explicitly prohibit the vendor from using any customer content for model training. Third, it must also prohibit use of customer content for service improvement. And fourth, all processing must occur exclusively within the European Union. These four points are non-negotiable under our standard and need to be captured in the redline before I can give my privacy findings for your final approval. I'd like to formally put these on the record now so they can be incorporated.
